speaker: Khettara Bloom cast
direction: The Khettara Bloom briefings (wellhollow-bloom-arc.md). COLONEL ORENS is the APDF district field commander (Brock, owner's cast 2026-10-30): plain, competent and confident in command; never tired, stressed or urgent (owner, 2026-10-30). CASTLE is the company operations voice shared with every arc. Treatment: dialogue, in the room. Synthesis text is one direction tag plus the current string; tools/generate_wellhollow_audio.py refuses a take whose string has changed until the tag line is refreshed.

lines.text: You're Castle? Colonel Orens, Khettara district. I have one regular battalion, the reservists from every town in the basin, and three merc outfits I hired this morning. You're the fourth.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: You're Castle? Colonel Orens, Khettara district. I have one regular battalion, the reservists from every town in the basin, and three merc outfits I hired this morning. You're the fourth.

lines.text: What's happening down there?
lines.speaker: @dialogueSpeakerCastle
lines.synthesisText: [calm, businesslike] What's happening down there?

lines.text: The ground opened under Tazrout. It's a ravager bloom, and they're coming up in the wet basins all over Asharu at once. Command has regulars responding in the strategic objectives. Out here, we're the far end of everybody's list.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [grim, matter-of-fact] The ground opened under Tazrout. It's a ravager bloom, and they're coming up in the wet basins all over Asharu at once. Command has regulars responding in the strategic objectives. Out here, we're the far end of everybody's list.

lines.text: Where do you want us?
lines.speaker: @dialogueSpeakerCastle
lines.synthesisText: [calm, businesslike] Where do you want us?

lines.text: Tazrout, the farm town on the basin floor. Most of it is holed up round the civil-defence compound. My battalion is holding the water works and the port, the other outfits have the airfields, and nobody has Tazrout. Bring the VIPs out of the shelter on your shuttles.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: Tazrout, the farm town on the basin floor. Most of it is holed up round the civil-defence compound. My battalion is holding the water works and the port, the other outfits have the airfields, and nobody has Tazrout. Bring the VIPs out of the shelter on your shuttles.

lines.text: And the bores?
lines.speaker: @dialogueSpeakerCastle
lines.synthesisText: [calm] And the bores?

lines.text: There's a deep one under Tazrout. If you can put it down, put it down.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: There's a deep one under Tazrout. If you can put it down, put it down.

lines.text: Where do we set down?
lines.speaker: @dialogueSpeakerCastle
lines.synthesisText: [businesslike] Where do we set down?

lines.text: The fields south of town. My reservists have dug a ring there round a lift: trench, wire, an aid station, ammunition. That's your staging post. They hold the ring. You're the muscle that goes into Tazrout and brings the VIPs back through the gate.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [decisive, giving orders] The fields south of town. My reservists have dug a ring there round a lift: trench, wire, an aid station, ammunition. That's your staging post. They hold the ring. You're the muscle that goes into Tazrout and brings the VIPs back through the gate.

lines.text: Other small settlements across the surface have activating bores. Same contract, Castle. Get the people out.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [steady] Other small settlements across the surface have activating bores. Same contract, Castle. Get the people out.

lines.text: The APDF still needs that ground walked, Castle. Same work, a different day, half the fee.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [dry, businesslike] The APDF still needs that ground walked, Castle. Same work, a different day, half the fee.

lines.text: We have a line now. Redoubts across the rim roads, reservists in the trenches, the farms walked out behind it. For the first time this month my staff knows where everybody is.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [quietly satisfied] We have a line now. Redoubts across the rim roads, reservists in the trenches, the farms walked out behind it. For the first time this month my staff knows where everybody is.

lines.text: Then why call us?
lines.speaker: @dialogueSpeakerCastle
lines.synthesisText: [curious] Then why call us?

lines.text: Ain Tafrant. It's the pumping town at the basin's low end, and the line went round it. Civilians and a small guard holed up in the compound. We need a fast action force that can help to get those people out of there.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [grim] Ain Tafrant. It's the pumping town at the basin's low end, and the line went round it. Civilians and a small guard holed up in the compound. We need a fast action force that can help to get those people out of there.

lines.text: And your regulars?
lines.speaker: @dialogueSpeakerCastle
lines.synthesisText: [dry] And your regulars?

lines.text: Pulled north. Regional Command is pushing it's own offensives, and Ain Tafrant isn't on that map. I only have enough reserves to hold this line and provide ground lift. I need someone to keep those trucks moving.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [dry, frustrated, then decisive] Pulled north. Regional Command is pushing it's own offensives, and Ain Tafrant isn't on that map. I only have enough reserves to hold this line and provide ground lift. I need someone to keep those trucks moving.

lines.text: We hold the town while your trucks run them out through the gap, back to your camp.
lines.speaker: @dialogueSpeakerCastle
lines.synthesisText: [businesslike] We hold the town while your trucks run them out through the gap, back to your camp.

lines.text: Exactly right, we'll need to do about 5 loads to get everyone. The ravs are getting more active by the minute so the faster we get this done the better.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [firm] Exactly right, we'll need to do about 5 loads to get everyone. The ravs are getting more active by the minute so the faster we get this done the better.

lines.text: The APDF still needs that ground walked, Castle. Same work, a different day, half the fee.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [dry, businesslike] The APDF still needs that ground walked, Castle. Same work, a different day, half the fee.

lines.text: How's the offensive, Orens?
lines.speaker: @dialogueSpeakerCastle
lines.synthesisText: [curious] How's the offensive, Orens?

lines.text: The bloom went east along the irrigation channels and seeded a second root in the thick country, mothers on it. Regional Command has sent us batteries and two more battalions, and your company is attached to my brigade.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [confident, briefing] The bloom went east along the irrigation channels and seeded a second root in the thick country, mothers on it. Regional Command has sent us batteries and two more battalions, and your company is attached to my brigade.

lines.text: What's our piece?
lines.speaker: @dialogueSpeakerCastle
lines.synthesisText: [businesslike] What's our piece?

lines.text: The batteries walk a barrage up the channels. My infantry burn the growth behind it. Your company takes the lane down the middle, to the mothers.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [confident, precise] The batteries walk a barrage up the channels. My infantry burn the growth behind it. Your company takes the lane down the middle, to the mothers.

lines.text: We stay close behind the shells and burn as we go.
lines.speaker: @dialogueSpeakerCastle
lines.synthesisText: [calm] We stay close behind the shells and burn as we go.

lines.text: Burnt ground stays ours for a while. Keep close. The barrage won't wait for you.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [firm, confident] Burnt ground stays ours for a while. Keep close. The barrage won't wait for you.

lines.text: The channel root is still standing. The batteries have shells for one more timetable. Go in behind them.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [firm] The channel root is still standing. The batteries have shells for one more timetable. Go in behind them.

lines.text: The APDF still needs that ground walked, Castle. Same work, a different day, half the fee.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [dry, businesslike] The APDF still needs that ground walked, Castle. Same work, a different day, half the fee.

lines.text: The guns are on the first ride. Sector one is burning; walk in behind it.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [calm, confident, on the radio] The guns are on the first ride. Sector one is burning; walk in behind it.

lines.text: Lifting to sector two, on the second ride. Keep up with it.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [calm, matter-of-fact, on the radio] Lifting to sector two, on the second ride. Keep up with it.

lines.text: Sector three, along the brook. Past it, the mothers are yours.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [confident, on the radio] Sector three, along the brook. Past it, the mothers are yours.

lines.text: The channel root is down, and for the first time since this started, Regional Command in its infinite wisdom has decided to bring in the regulars. I'm now organizing this motley crew of auxiliaries and relaying orders to you.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [sardonic, then businesslike] The channel root is down, and for the first time since this started, Regional Command in its infinite wisdom has decided to bring in the regulars. I'm now organizing this motley crew of auxiliaries and relaying orders to you.

lines.text: Then we're going for the heart.
lines.speaker: @dialogueSpeakerCastle
lines.synthesisText: [steady] Then we're going for the heart.

lines.text: That's right. Under the old well field: mothers on one reservoir, bores round them. They fed on the forest biomass and are still harvesting. We're going to put an end to that.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [confident, grim] That's right. Under the old well field: mothers on one reservoir, bores round them. They fed on the forest biomass and are still harvesting. We're going to put an end to that.

lines.text: And the company?
lines.speaker: @dialogueSpeakerCastle
lines.synthesisText: [businesslike] And the company?

lines.text: The spearhead lane. My columns take ground and hold it. You go for the mothers. When the last one falls, the heart is down.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [confident, giving orders] The spearhead lane. My columns take ground and hold it. You go for the mothers. When the last one falls, the heart is down.

lines.text: The heart is still standing and the columns are back on the start line. One more push, Castle.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [confident, rallying] The heart is still standing and the columns are back on the start line. One more push, Castle.

lines.text: The APDF still needs that ground walked, Castle. Same work, a different day, half the fee.
lines.speaker: @wellhollowSpeakerWarden
lines.synthesisText: [dry, businesslike] The APDF still needs that ground walked, Castle. Same work, a different day, half the fee.
